semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Synopex Inc. provides critical filtration and purification components that support the assembly and packaging processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Synopex Inc. specializes in advanced membrane and filter technologies, focusing on flexible printed circuit boards (FPCB) for IT electronics. The company offers essential filtration components such as liquid and oil filters, getters, purifiers, and catalysts for gases, leveraging nanotechnology to enhance semiconductor manufacturing environments.
